WHY THESE TWO ACTS MATTER. Rosario Nicotra was born about 1800 at Giarre and his father was SIMONE NICOTRA, husband of Marianna Musumeci — the deepest generation this archive has reached, and known only from Rosario's 1890 death act. Giuseppe Nicotra, born about 1797 at Giarre and a contadino, is Rosario's near-exact contemporary, and his father Sebastiano, born about 1770, stands in SIMONE'S OWN GENERATION. Cirino, born about 1740, stands one above it. These are the first Nicotra households of Giarre this archive has ever documented, and they sit exactly where Simone's own parents and brothers would sit. NOTHING IS ATTACHED. Giuseppe is not Rosario's brother — their parents are different couples. Whether Simone was a son of Cirino, or a brother of Sebastiano, or neither, is not established by these acts and no edge is drawn from them. The question is filed as q19.
